title: Logged equivalent — 16 kHz AAC, 32 kbps
scope: Same native 48 kHz capture reduced to 16 kHz mono and encoded AAC at 32 kbit/s, then decoded for embedded playback. Approximation of current Connect/video format, not actual old-firmware capture or exact on-device resampling/encoder equivalence. Existing clock/startup clicks are not recreated. Raw rlogs use 16 kHz PCM; qlogs contain no audio. Native 48 kHz here is experimental capture; production micd still defaults to 16 kHz.
